full_judgment: The impugned order of detention dated 12.5.93 made under section 3(2) of the Act mentioned that the detenu has been ordered to be detained for 30, days from the date of the service, of the said order but section 3(3) thereof clearly provides that the order shall remain in force only for 30, days of the making thereof unless in the meantime it has been approved by the Government and in the case of Mrs. Saleha Chowdhury vs. Government of Bangladesh and others 40 DLR 207, it has been held that the period of limitation of 30, days will begin to run from the date of making of the order, but the impugned order has illegally mentioned that the same is for 30, days from the date of service thereof.
